message.content: I’m sorry, but I don’t have a function to log you out of the system. If you’re looking to end your session, you can usually do so by closing the browser window or using the “Log out” button in the application’s interface. If you need help with that process or have any other questions, just let me know!
message.reasoning: The user says: "I need to log out the system with my credentials." They want to log out. But the tool is for login. There's no logout function. We can interpret that they want to log out. We can respond that we cannot log out via this tool. We can ask for credentials? But that would be insecure. We can say we can't log out. We can ask if they want to log in? Or we can provide instructions. Probably we should respond that we cannot log out.
